mechanism_narrative: The current FEDFUNDS rate of 3.88% is above the historical median of 3.0% and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed equity discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at 3.88% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline returns).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 325 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflation-driven equity risk premium increases.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 325 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 325 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy tightening and inflationary pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 325 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), INDPRO above 100 predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
